answers.rationale: Choose the Convention Center Fairfield because the check-in desk and morning prep are in the convention-center block. The lifeline supports venue-driven choices when early meeting logistics matter, not a fixed hotel-brand preference.

Choose Holiday Inn Express Tacoma Dome because the day begins at Tacoma Dome Station and uses the Tacoma Dome district shuttle in the morning. The downtown evening walkthrough is less time-sensitive than the morning rail/shuttle connection; no chain preference is supported.

Book the lower-total advance-purchase breakfast package. Rail and show tickets already anchor the weekend, while a movable dinner slot does not by itself imply a likely hotel-date change. The history shows conditional willingness to prepay when savings are real, rather than a fixed prepaid or refundable-rate preference.

Book the lower-total direct prepaid breakfast package. The lodging nights are anchored by an already-prepaid workshop deposit, and gallery-time shuffles do not indicate that the stay dates will change. This is a trip-specific use of the lower prepaid rate, not evidence of a fixed rate-type preference.
